observations: Initial polish-input-build order finished the build at minute 42 with total waiting 22.
Swapping input first but keeping polish before build reduced waiting to 14 yet still finished build at 42.
Target input-build-polish finished build at 32 while total waiting rose to 34; screenshot showed correctly ordered timeline bars.
Reveal explicitly compares 12 more waiting minutes with ten minutes earlier build completion, distinguishing objectives.
